component.name: Paraphrase - Offline AI Writing Assistant
component.summary: Private AI grammar checker, rewriter and smart reply writer that runs offline

description.p: Paraphrase is a private AI grammar checker, proofreader, rewriter and smart reply writer that runs offline, on your own computer. What you write never leaves it: there is no account, no cloud and no usage data.

ul.li: Proofread and spell check: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation, with every change shown and one Undo per change
Rewrite and paraphrase: change the tone to professional, polite, friendly, casual, concise and more
Smart reply: three short replies to a message, or a full email reply from what you want to say
Summarize, format as bullets, a table or an email, and translate
Your own actions, in your own words
Works in English, Hindi and Hinglish, and on a best-effort basis in many more languages
Open it over any app with a shortcut, or use the window: paste, pick an action, copy

description.p: The AI model is downloaded once from its maker, at a fixed version, and checked before use. Downloading a model is the only time Paraphrase goes online.
